meta.description: A model of the 2017 Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack which targeted specific Triconex Safety Controllers.
meta.article: Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack was a campaign employed by TEMP.Veles which leveraged the Triton malware framework against a petrochemical organization. The malware and techniques used within this campaign targeted specific Triconex Safety Controllers within the environment.

data.label: Overview
user_properties:
Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack was a campaign employed by TEMP.Veles 
which leveraged the Triton malware framework against a petrochemical organization.
The malware and techniques used within this campaign targeted specific 
Triconex Safety Controllers within the environment. The incident was eventually 
discovered due to a safety trip that occurred as a result of an issue in the malware.
